thread.title: Futures Surrender Early Gains as 10-Year Treasury Note Flirts with 3%, FOMC Meeting End Looms

author: MT Newswires
title: Futures Surrender Early Gains as 10-Year Treasury Note Flirts with 3%, FOMC Meeting End Looms
text:
Shutterstock photo Stock futures have pared their earlier gains with Dow and Standard and Poor's futures slipping into negative territory and the Nasdaq clinging to a very modest gain as the 10-year Treasury yield inches closer to 3%. The bid generated by Apple's ( AAPL ) strong quarterly results started to fade as Wall Street braced for the conclusion to the two-day Federal Open Market Committee meeting, and the possibility for more tape bombs from Washington as Special Counsel Robert Mueller continues his investigation on the 2016 presidential campaign.
While there's a less than 10% chance for the FOMC to hike rates Wednesday, the statement will be dissected for a change in language signalling a June rate hike. The FOMC meeting concludes at 2 pm ET.
Labor market data had little impact on futures despite a solid beat on a monthly payroll indicator. According to ADP, the private sector added 204,000 jobs in April with the majority of new jobs coming from the services sector. Nearly all industries that were measured showed gains with the exception of the information industry, which added 7,000 fewer jobs in April.
Overseas markets were mixed with Asia mostly lower but European shares buoyed by bullish manufacturing and construction PMIs. China's Caixin manufacturing index increased slightly to 51.1 from 51.0 in March, but slower export orders suggests Q2 growth could slow.
